facts.fact: Gabon Media Time reports Gabon adopted the DHIS2 Tracker, which lets health establishments enter patient-level information before its integration into the national DHIS2 system, after a preparatory phase with trainer training and real-conditions tests in several facilities, with extension to four health districts by September 2026 and progressive national generalisation in 2027.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with WHO technical support

note: as_of is the article's published date, as it gives no date for the adoption.
